parts.label: a · Material composition dependence
parts.explanation: In the chapter free-electron model, g(E) has universal coefficient for the electron mass; composition does not enter at a fixed band energy.

parts.label: b · Sample-size dependence
parts.explanation: Total levels per energy are Vg(E), so spacing scales as 1/V.

parts.label: c · Position within band dependence
parts.explanation: g(E) grows as√E; adjacent levels are closer higher in the band.

parts.label: d · Temperature dependence
parts.explanation: In a freely expanding sample, temperature changes volume V through thermal expansion, so adjacent spacing 1/[Vg(E)] changes. At fixed volume, temperature has no direct effect on g(E); it changes occupancy instead.

parts.label: e · Fermi-energy dependence at fixed E

reasoning: Use level spacing≈1/[Vg(E)] and distinguish state availability from occupancy. Verification: In the chapter free-electron model, g(E) has universal coefficient for the electron mass; composition does not enter at a fixed band energy.

scope: Use the chapter free-electron model at fixed specified energy E. Part (d) allows the ordinary thermal expansion of the physical sample, since its volume is not constrained. At fixed volume the spacing would have no direct temperature dependence. Ignore band-structure/effective-mass corrections.
